caption: The drawing depicts a brown ceramic pitcher with a high-gloss finish, featuring ornate yellow and gold decorative patterns near the spout and around the top half of the vessel. Below the rim, a row of rounded, bead-like protrusions encircles the pitcher. The body of the pitcher is adorned with a detailed scene that appears to show small human figures and animals, set amongst green and yellow flora, rendered in relief against the brown background. The handle is substantial, arching from the upper body to just above the base, with further decorative detailing. Near the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a separate circular image of a brown and gold medallion or pottery mark, which reads "Wm. E. Warner's Pottery West Troy N.Y." The overall composition is centered on the pitcher, with a simple, neutral background and a faint rectangular outline framing the pitcher and medallion.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
